label: Ещё
description: A 10-sentence usage card for ещё (still; yet; more).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Continuation up to now. Here 'ещё' means still, signalling that the sleeping that began earlier is ongoing. With a present-tense verb it stresses that the state has not yet changed.
Strategic focus: Not yet in questions. In the negative question 'ещё не' means not yet, asking whether an expected event still has not happened. It carries a light note of impatience.
Strategic focus: Quantity sense more. With a noun 'ещё' means more or another portion, requesting an additional amount of coffee. Placed before the noun it scales the quantity, not the time.
Strategic focus: Reassurance about a remaining supply. 'Ещё' combines with 'много' to stress that plenty still remains. It reassures that the resource has not run out yet.

missions.phrase: Я хочу остаться здесь ещё немного.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: A little longer. With 'немного' the adverb 'ещё' extends an action by a short additional stretch. It frames staying as a continuation beyond the expected end.

missions.phrase: Расскажи мне об этом ещё раз.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Repetition with раз. The set phrase 'ещё раз' means one more time, requesting a repeated action. This is the standard way to ask someone to do something again.
Strategic focus: Still in a yes-no question. 'Ещё' asks whether the shop remains open at the moment of speaking. It checks that a state has not yet ended.
Strategic focus: Future continuation. With a perfective future verb 'ещё' promises that the meeting will happen again. It points forward to another occurrence to come.
Strategic focus: Intensifying a comparative. Before 'сильнее' the adverb 'ещё' means even, boosting the comparative by a further degree. It adds another step beyond an already high level.

Strategic focus: As recently as. At the front of the sentence 'ещё вчера' means as recently as yesterday, contrasting a near past with a changed present. The fronted position highlights the surprising shift.
